translation_snapshot.source:
Your study of arcane forces has let you develop a new way of applying your aptitude for trapping and poisons.

		You gain 1.0 mastery in the Cunning/Poisons and Cunning/Trapping talent trees.
		Your Venomous Strike talent cooldown is reduced by 3.
		Your Lure talent cooldown is reduced by 5.

		You learn the following talents:
%s
translation_snapshot.target:
通过对奥术之力的研究，你找到了运用自己陷阱与毒药天赋的新方式。

你在灵巧/毒药系和灵巧/陷阱系技能树上获得 1.0 系数。
		你的毒素爆发技能冷却时间减少 3。
		你的诱饵技能冷却时间减少 5。

		你可以学会：
%s

translation_snapshot.source:
Activate the rune to unleash a cone dealing %0.2f acid damage.
			The corrosive acid will also disarm enemies struck for %d turns.
			This effect can be resisted but not saved against.
translation_snapshot.target:
发射锥形酸浪，造成 %0.2f 酸性伤害。
			腐蚀性酸液会缴械目标 %d 回合。
			效果可以被抵抗，但不能被豁免。

translation_snapshot.source: Your combat focus allows you to regenerate life faster (+%0.1f life/turn).
translation_snapshot.target: 你专注于战斗，使你可以更快的回复生命值（+%0.1f 生命值/回合）。

translation_snapshot.source: Strike the target with both weapons dealing %d%% damage with each hit.  Each strike that hits will increase the duration of the lowest duration disease effect by %d.
translation_snapshot.target: 向目标挥舞两把武器，每次攻击造成 %d%% 伤害，每次攻击将会使目标身上持续时间最短的疾病效果的持续时间延长 %d 回合。

translation_snapshot.source: A tiny arachnid that phases in and out of reality.
translation_snapshot.target: 一只小小的蜘蛛，它在不断的出入相位现实。

translation_snapshot.source:
#GOLD#Feedback#LAST#
Feedback represents using pain as a means of psionic grounding and it can be used to power feedback abilities.
Feedback decays at the rate of 10% or 1 per turn (which ever is greater) depending on talents.
All damage you take from an outside source will increase your Feedback based on to how much of your health is lost and your level.  First level characters gain 100 Feedback when losing 50% health, while 50th level characters gain the same amount when losing 20% health.
translation_snapshot.target:
#GOLD#反馈值#LAST#
反馈值反映你能利用你的痛苦来释放灵能，可以用于释放反馈系技能。
反馈值每回合按 10% 或 1 点（取较大者）衰减，具体衰减速率还受技能影响。
你从外界受到的所有伤害都会增加你的反馈值，增加的数值取决于你损失生命值的百分比和你的等级。1级人物在损失50%生命后获得100反馈值，而50级人物损失20%生命后获得同样多的反馈值。

translation_snapshot.source: A piece of the scorched wood taken from the remains of Snaproot.
translation_snapshot.target: 从远古树精身上得到的木头残片。

translation_snapshot.source:
Lay Warp Mines in a radius of 1 that teleport enemies away from you and inflict %0.2f physical and %0.2f temporal (warp) damage.
		The mines are hidden traps (%d detection and %d disarm power based on your Magic) and last for %d turns.
		The damage caused by your Warp Mines will improve with your Spellpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
在半径 1 的范围里埋设地雷，将敌人传送远离你身边并造成 %0.2f 物理和 %0.2f 时空伤害。
		地雷是隐藏的陷阱（%d 侦查强度 %d 解除强度基于魔法），持续 %d 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。
